title: well-known publisher config
description: Config for the well-known publisher composite action. Any string value may reference an env var via ${{ env.NAME }}; write $${{ to publish a literal ${{ (one $ is dropped and the expression is left as written).

version.description: Schema version; only 1 is accepted today.

output_dir.description: Directory generators write into. Caller-provided default wins over this.

deploy.description: Optional deploy mode handled by the caller workflow.

worker_endpoint.description: Endpoint used when deploy = worker; ignored otherwise.

resources.description: Per-resource generator configs. Each resource generator adds its registry name here plus a $defs entry; none exist yet, so no keys are accepted.

custom.description: Escape hatch: arbitrary files written under .well-known/.

path.description: Target path, relative and under .well-known/. Each /-separated segment must be non-empty, must not be . or .., and must not contain a backslash or a control character, so the file always lands inside the output directory.
